video_title: History May Tell Us What Comes Next For Clippers + INTERESTING Signings Updates In The West

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers have not yet faced legal action over Kawhi Leonard trade
quotes.excerpt: As of now, we have no lawsuit or any reaction formally from the Clippers.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It is a holiday weekend, not a lot of business is getting done. As of now, we have no lawsuit or any reaction formally from the Clippers. I have no information that one is coming, but it has all been quiet on the front. The Clippers have not made any statement in days.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I mean, they made two pretty loud statements in the immediate aftermath.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors-Clippers trade for Kawhi Leonard has not gone through
quotes.excerpt: The trade between the Raptors and the Clippers for Kawhi Leonard has not gone through.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The trade between the Raptors and the Clippers for Kawhi Leonard has not gone through.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, again, this is Monday night. We will see what happens on Tuesday. In talking to people, I think that trade is going to go through, and I think it is going to go through as is. I was scolded for implying, or maybe not implying, but wondering whether or not the terms could get traded. The terms could get altered. They have agreed on this trade, and I think they are going to go through with it as constructed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Details of the proposed Raptors-Clippers trade for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Coming to the Clippers is Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two unprotected firsts, 2031 and 2033, and a pick swap.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: To remind you, coming to the Clippers is Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two unprotected firsts, 2031 and 2033, and a pick swap in 2028 in the Clippers' favor.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: 28? I thought it was 27 was the big swap.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Oh no. I am not debating. I am sure you are right. I am not debating. I do not have it in front of me. I am yielding to you on this one.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I believe it is 27, which would mean basically the right to swap with Oklahoma City.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer received benefit of the doubt from other owners
quotes.excerpt: I think Steve Ballmer largely was getting the benefit of the doubt from his peer owners through this process.
quotes.quote: I think Steve Ballmer largely was getting the benefit of the doubt from his peer owners through this process. I know that there were some people who believed that he was, especially the teams that were trying to get Kawhi Leonard back in 2019 and heard out of Uncle Dennis's mouth the requests that came through here, and the teams that were impacted by Kawhi picking the Clippers, they may not have felt that way. But the teams that were not in the mix, they wanted to believe him. And the word that was said to me by a very influential person was that some of the other owners were aghast when they read this report.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers should accept penalty and negotiate later
quotes.excerpt: I advise the Clippers to accept the penalty and try to leave room to negotiate later.
quotes.quote: I advise the Clippers to accept the penalty and try to leave room to negotiate later. I heavily researched what happened with Minnesota in 2000. Do you know when the Timberwolves got their first draft pick restored? It was two days after they played guilty. The penalty came down in October, and the Wolves had their first returned pick back before Christmas. The Wolves at first were in denial. The process was different back then. They used an arbiter and not a law firm. But when the Wolves were found guilty, Glen Taylor said words that were not 'I am guilty.' Kevin McHale, who was the vice president of basketball operations, said words like 'I did not even know this existed.' He played ignorance. They thought about it, and they negotiated with the league office and they pleaded guilty. And two days after they basically they raised the white flag in December, David Stern gave them back a pick. And a year later, he gave them back the second pick.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard should talk to authorities if he didn't know
quotes.excerpt: If Kawhi did not know that Uncle Dennis was getting him 30-plus million dollars in endorsement deals.
quotes.quote: I cannot prove what Kawhi Leonard knew and when he knew it. The implication that he did not know this was happening, and I saw Draymond Green and others came out and said 'I believe him.' Listen, I do not know what Kawhi knew. But I do know this: If Kawhi did not know that Uncle Dennis was getting him 30-plus million dollars in endorsement deals he was not working for, then Kawhi needs to talk to authorities because that would be multiple-level felony if you were misrepresenting somebody and taking money on their behalf. To my knowledge, that has not happened.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers and Nets suffered from 'Little Brother Syndrome'
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers were guilty of the same thing that the Nets were. They had Little Brother Syndrome.
quotes.quote: The Clippers were guilty of the same thing that the Nets were. They had Little Brother Syndrome, and they really tried to they were so focused on not being the little brother anymore that they took way too big a gamble.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's five-year, $208 million extension with Rockets
quotes.excerpt: Amen Thompson signed his five-year, $208 million extension with the Houston Rockets.
quotes.quote: Amen Thompson signed his five-year, $208 million extension with the Houston Rockets. The Rockets obviously were pleased with doing this because they have been a team that has held their ground in rookie extensions, whether it was with Jabari Smith, Alperen Sengun, or Jalen Green. Jalen Green, that was a definitely a creative deal that happened near the deadline.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Rockets value Amen Thompson as a top-10 player
quotes.excerpt: If there is one untradeable player on the roster, it is him.
quotes.quote: If there is one untradeable player on the roster, it is him. According to their metrics, they think he is one of the top 10, and I might be inflating that number, most valuable players in the league. Now, we can argue and we can debate, and you can say that is ridiculous. I am just telling you the way that they view him. And so for them to get a player they value that much on this deal is at great value for them.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's shooting and ball-handling development
quotes.excerpt: His shooting is an issue, and his ball-handling is he has got some wiggle.
quotes.quote: There is no doubt that his offense is an issue, and that has been what we have talked about since he was coming out of overtime and post-high school. There is no doubt that his offense is an issue. His shooting is an issue, and his ball-handling is he has got some wiggle. He is a dynamic finisher, obviously. He is a good playmaker, not great, but a good playmaker. He is good attacking off the dribble. He is just a complete non-shooter at this point.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons signs one-year, $3.5 million deal with Kings
quotes.excerpt: Ben Simmons resigned in the NBA. Ben Simmons signs with the Kings, a one-year, $3.5 million deal.
quotes.quote: Ben Simmons resigned in the NBA. Ben Simmons signs with the Kings, a one-year, $3.5 million deal.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson is a young superstar version of Ben Simmons
quotes.excerpt: I think Amen Thompson like the best version of him is a young superstar version of Ben Simmons.
quotes.quote: I think Amen Thompson like the best version of him is a young superstar version of Ben Simmons, the best version of him offensively. Really, I think that is the best comp for him. Ben Simmons was a superstar. I am just telling you I think that is the kind of player that Amen Thompson can be.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons is no longer a point guard
quotes.excerpt: I don't know what Ben Simmons is in today's NBA. I don't think he can be a point guard anymore.
quotes.quote: I don't know what Ben Simmons is in today's NBA. I don't think he can be a point guard anymore. I don't think he has that kind of quickness and athleticism anymore. You could talk me into him being some kind of second-unit playmaking power forward.
